derivation: from H4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and H6664 (צֶדֶק); king of right;
def: Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine

occurrences.text: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
